name: Browser Use Cloud
description: Delegate browser tasks and watch them live in Paperclip.

methods.whenToUse: Use credentials from your provider account.
methods.guidanceMd: Create an API key in [Browser Use settings](https://cloud.browser-use.com/settings) and paste it below. Your agents can browse websites while you watch and interact from the task's Browser tab.
methods.label: Browser Use Cloud

credentialFields.label: API key
credentialFields.helperMd: Open Browser Use → Settings → API keys. Create a key for the project agents should use.
